scope: Shared fork-forest reconciliation and sparse operation aliases; current-format facts, outcomes and user history retained

algorithms.ancestry: One iterative preorder interval forest shared by cumulative measurements and operations; exact identities sorted once, oldest recorded ancestor selected in a linear pass
algorithms.evidence: Merge operation metadata by owner, sort/deduplicate physical references once per owner
algorithms.aliases: Canonical identities resolve through existing operations; only alternate native identities occupy the alias map
algorithms.work: O((T+E)log(T+E)+PlogP), with T relationship nodes, E candidate events and P physical references
algorithms.persistence: No new index, DTO or snapshot layout; no migration or user-record deletion
algorithms.cycles: Retain facts for cycles and descendants; expose forkAncestryCycle rather than deleting mutual copies to zero
